Where does strata cleaning run in Melbourne?

Strata cleaning runs across Melbourne's building corridors – CBD towers, Docklands apartments and Southbank mixed-use sites.

The roster also reaches Fitzroy walk-ups, Richmond townhouse complexes, South Yarra blocks, Carlton student housing and Hawthorn garden complexes, dispatched from the nearest hub.

Buildings outside the corridor list run the same audit-first sequence once a route sits on the roster.
